objective: Test whether bounded explicit output-cell contacts remove vocabulary-times-reservoir scaling without hiding a classifier, then measure capability only after mechanics and hyperparameters are frozen.
claim_boundary: No capability or held-out result has been run for this protocol. Mechanics, allocation, and tiny exactness tests are not evidence of language, SWE, inhibitory winner-take-all, e-prop equivalence, or human anatomical fidelity.

unlock_requirements: commit the implementation and this protocol
commit a runner that verifies this protocol hash and every external file hash
pass all mechanics, native, checkpoint, and allocation gates
record the train-only selected configuration before opening the one-access cohort

one_access_confirmation.role: external validation after every selection is frozen
one_access_confirmation.access_policy: Run every frozen condition once and report all files and seeds. Any later design change requires v2 and these v1 results remain visible.

sparse_rule.structural_schedule_semantics: Scheduled per-target maintenance runs on correct and wrong presentations; recruitment is not coupled to an error event.

controls: sparse K=N independent scalar/local-rule oracle at tiny N
untrained sparse anatomy and pacemaker-only controls

selection.scope: Only fan-in and learning rate may be selected from the declared grid, using the named training files and three paired seeds at 384 cells.
ordering: reject any condition failing exactness, bounded-growth, Dale-sign, or finite-state gates
maximize median train-only teacher-forced byte accuracy
break ties by median train-only free-running aligned byte accuracy
break remaining ties by lower actual sparse-readout bytes
selection.freeze_record: Record selected K, learning rate, protocol SHA-256, implementation commit, and complete train-only grid before external access.

storage: C fixed potential IDs and traces per output
exactly K capacity IDs/weights/ages per output
capacity IDs sorted unique and a subset of potential IDs
zero weight means vacant and functional learning skips it
exactness: K=N candidate and contact IDs equal arange(N)
K=N current, winner, update count, weights, race, reset, and continuation equality
checkpoint v3 exact next teaching and counter-based turnover continuation
malformed candidate order and contact subsets rejected
native_and_sign: all rates, gates, and decays validated before FFI
all excitatory readout weights finite and nonnegative
CUDA rejected unless a separate exact-parity gate is registered

locality_and_timing: global top-eligible selection as explicitly nonlocal engineering control

finite_difference.procedure: On one fitted cell and a tiny circuit, central-difference the target response with respect to each occupied input and compare direction and normalized error with the local pre-times-post trace.
finite_difference.reporting: Report correlation, sign agreement, and relative error for every state. Do not call the trace e-prop-equivalent from analogy alone.

dale_and_competition: isolated signed-weight diagnostic that can never be promoted to production
future explicit shared-inhibitory-cell circuit with remove-inhibition control before any inhibitory WTA claim
turnover_and_homeostasis: top-eligible RigL-like reactivation as engineering-only control
preregistered_ablations.execution_note: Ablation mechanisms not present in the committed implementation must be added and frozen before any capability execution; no post-result condition may be added.

throughput_case.rule: Report CPU sparse-readout throughput honestly. CUDA cannot qualify until exact sparse-readout parity is separately registered.

analysis.primary_comparison: paired sparse minus dense-three-factor change at 6144 cells on the untouched external cohort
analysis.scale_check: report every seed and size; larger is beneficial only if both capability and responsive/activity diagnostics avoid collapse
analysis.memory_interpretation: Use actual serialized/persistent array bytes. The ratio is a function of N and selected K; do not claim 100x at every calibratable size.
analysis.multiple_comparison_policy: Only the frozen selected sparse condition versus the dense historical control is confirmatory. All mechanism and C/K lanes are descriptive ablations.
analysis.failure_policy: Report a failed external, scaling, memory, or throughput criterion without retuning v1.
